title: Scan report record
description: One line of a scan report in JSON Lines. A report describes one scanned input: its first line is the top-level object, and every later line is an object the scanner reached inside it, each after its parent.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema the record follows.

objectId.description: The object's identifier, unique within one report.

depth.description: How deep the scanner was when it reached the object, the top-level object being 0. A child is deeper than its parent, though not necessarily by one: a scanner may pass through levels it does not report as objects.

type.description: The file type the scanner settled on for the object, by the reference scanner's own type names such as CL_TYPE_ZIP; null when the scanner did not type it.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the object's bytes, in lowercase hexadecimal.

detections.description: The name of each signature that matched the object, once per time it was reported, in the order reported.

verdict.description: What the scan reported for the input as a whole.

scanner.description: Which scanner wrote the report, and the databases it had loaded.

databases.description: Each loaded database by its file name without extension, with the version in its header, sorted by name.

topLevelObject.description: The input itself. Always the first line of a report.

object.description: An object the scanner reached inside the input.
